data.title: Your daily horoscope for Oct 28
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on. ✨= today's motto,⏰ = work, ₿ = money, ❤️= taken, ⚤ = single

data.title: Em District Haunted Carnivalset to scare up Sukhumvit fun
data.description: The three iconic shopping destinations in the heart of Sukhumvit have been transformed into a fantastical carnival with a spooky twist during the Em District Haunted Carnival, which is running until Saturday.

data.title: Nene Royal to perform at  Happitat's Spooktacular Festival
data.description: Happitat, a lifestyle and retail destination on Bang Na-Trat Road, invites everyone to step into a mysterious Halloween world of magic and wonder during its Spooktacular Festival, which is running until Sunday.

data.title: Movies, music & more at Chula Klangplaeng 2026
data.description: An evening of outdoor cinema, live music, creative workshops and local stories awaits at Chula Klangplaeng 2026, returning for its third edition on Nov 6 at Chula 100th Anniversary Park.

data.title: World Bank offers $3.5m for canal
data.description: The government is preparing to accept a grant worth over 115 million baht from the World Bank to support preparations for a 165-billion-baht flood diversion canal project aimed at reducing flood risks in the lower Chao Phraya basin.

data.title: Tony Jacklin: A legend on and off the course
data.description: My paths first crossed with Tony Jacklin when I skipped school at just 12 years old and went up to London to see the then Ryder Cup team practise before heading off to the US. At 23, he was just starting out his career and I could see several of the older established players were wondering just who the young upstart was.

data.title: AI chip giant SK hynix says quarterly operating profit soars 630%
data.description: SEOUL - South Korean chip giant SK hynix said Wednesday its third-quarter operating profit soared 632 percent on-year, largely driven by the artificial intelligence industry's explosive demand for its advanced memory chips.

data.title: Arsenal stunned by fourth-tier Fleetwood in League Cup
data.description: FLEETWOOD (UNITED KINGDOM) - Arsenal suffered one of the most humiliating defeats in their history as the Premier League champions were stunned by fourth-tier minnows Fleetwood in a League Cup penalty shoot-out on Tuesday.

data.title: French Senate weighs bill to make protesters pay for unrest damage
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - The French parliament's upper house on Tuesday debated a controversial bill that would make protesters financially liable for damage caused during street demonstrations, despite warnings from critics that it could curb the right to protest.

data.title: Govt backs new tools for farmers
data.description: The government is ready to support innovation that adds value to agricultural products and helps farmers reach global markets, according to Kosol Pattama, adviser to the Minister attached to the Prime Minister's Office.

data.title: The sound of art
data.description: After retiring from his position as dean of the Faculty of Law at Chulalongkorn University, Prof Nantawat Boramanand has taken on a new mission -- to fund cochlear implant surgeries for children with hearing loss through the Foundation for the Deaf under the Royal Patronage of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit, The Queen Mother.

data.title: Seaplane plan set to take off
data.description: Deputy Transport Minister Phattrapong Phattraprasit is accelerating plans to introduce seaplane services in the Andaman region to boost tourism and the local economy while ensuring aviation safety and protecting the environment.

data.title: Russia back, Thai spikers draw United States test
data.description: Thailand will face five-time world champions the United States in the pool stage of the 2027 FIVB Women's Volleyball World Cup as the draw for the championship was unveiled on Monday night.

data.title: Unrest fears prompt OCA to push back event dates
data.description: The Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) and the Local Organising Committee (LOC) of the 6th Asian Indoor and Martial Arts Games Riyadh 2026 have confirmed that the Games will take place from March 28 to April 8, 2027, moving from the previously scheduled dates of Dec 11-21 this year.

data.title: Tough road ahead for War Elephants in Saudi
data.description: Thailand will begin their AFC Asian Cup 2027 campaign against two-time champions Qatar on Jan 11, four days after the tournament opens, with the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) on Tuesday confirming the kick-off times and venues for next year's competition in Saudi Arabia.

data.title: American woman convicted of getting military training from Islamic State
data.description: NEW YORK - An American woman who joined the Islamic State group before being caught by anti-IS forces in Syria was found guilty on Tuesday of receiving military training from the jihadists.

data.title: EC ends mayor's poll rights
data.description: The Election Commission (EC) has moved to revoke the electoral rights of Sila town mayor Phairat Thaweewan and 24 other individuals over alleged violations of election laws.

data.title: Buriram out to break a jinx
data.description: Thai League champions Buriram United will be hunting for their first win in the AFC Champions League Elite when they travel to face J1 League side Gamba Osaka in Japan Wednesday night.

data.title: Flood victims in Phuket to get payouts
data.description: Residents whose homes were damaged by flash floods and landslides in Phuket can qualify for disaster insurance compensation even if flooding lasted less than seven days, Deputy Interior Minister Worasit Liangprasit said.

data.title: Cop raids smash mule account ring
data.description: Police have arrested 11 suspects in a nationwide crackdown on a transnational network accused of creating and selling corporate mule accounts to scam gangs, money launderers and online gambling operators.

data.title: Pair held over illegal stroke-risk scans
data.description: Two people have been arrested for allegedly providing unlicensed medical services, including ultrasound examinations to assess stroke risk, at a restaurant in Bangkok's Bang Na district, charging 900 baht per customer.

data.title: Ties with China to boost green industry, low-carbon projects
data.description: Thailand and China have tightened cooperation on sustainable industrial development after the cabinet approved two projects worth a combined US$375,900 (12.7 million baht) under the Mekong-Lancang Cooperation Special Fund (MLCSF). The goal is to advance green industry, recycling technology, and low-carbon economic development.

data.title: Houthi attacks 'may imperil Thai Hajj pilgrims', says FM
data.description: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said Thailand is closely monitoring the escalating situation in the Middle East, expressing concern for Thai citizens performing the Hajj pilgrimage in Saudi Arabia amid fears the conflict may spread.

data.title: Rangsiman urges DSI to pursue case against Shuffle
data.description: People's Party list MP Rangsiman Rome has urged the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) to pursue a criminal case against those behind online gambling website Shuffle, saying there is sufficient evidence to proceed.

data.title: Cabinet approves cheaper fuel prices for 3 months
data.description: The cabinet has approved a three-month reduction in excise taxes on E20 gasohol and B20 biodiesel to help farmers, transport operators, and consumers while boosting demand for agricultural products used in biofuel production, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Tuesday.
